# Simple *hello world* application (with**out** modules)

A very simple *hello world* application that defines a main method and
configures the manifest accordingly, **without** using modules. The
[Maven](https://maven.apache.org/) build tool is used to simplify the process.

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. Build the application

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) List the compiled classes

   ```shell
   tree --dirsfirst --sort=name './target/classes'
   ```

   The application classes

   ```
   ./target/classes
   └── demo
       └── Main.class

   2 directories, 1 file
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR file was created and copied to the
   `./target/libs` directory.

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR file

   ```
   ./target/libs
   └── simple-hello-world-application-without-modules.jar

   1 directory, 1 file
   ```

2. List all modules

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/libs' --list-modules
   ```

3. Describe the JAR file

   Describe the `simple-hello-world-application-without-modules.jar`

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/simple-hello-world-application-without-modules.jar'
   ```

   The `simple-hello-world-application-without-modules` module description

   ```
   No module descriptor found. Derived automatic module.

   simple.hello.world.application.without.modules automatic
   requires java.base mandated
   contains demo
   main-class demo.Main
   ```

   Our JAR file can be loaded as an automatic module as indicated above, with
   the name `demo.without.modules`. This name will be used at a later step, when
   running the example using modules.

   Note that the module’s main class is defined, thus we can run the application
   without providing the main class canonical path.

   The main class is defined in the `META-INF/MANIFEST.MF` file that was created
   by maven.

   ```shell
   unzip -p './target/libs/simple-hello-world-application-without-modules.jar' 'META-INF/MANIFEST.MF'
   ```

   This will print the contents of the manifest file

   ```
   Manifest-Version: 1.0
   Created-By: Maven JAR Plugin 3.5.1
   Java-Version: 25
   Build-Jdk-Spec: 25
   Main-Class: demo.Main
   ```

4. Run the application

   Run the application using the class path (`-jar`)

   ```shell
   java \
     -jar './target/libs/simple-hello-world-application-without-modules.jar'
   ```

   The application will run and print the following

   ```
   Simple hello world application (without modules)
   Using Java 25.0.4.1
   Loaded as unmaned module (JAR file loaded through the class path)
   ```

   Run the application using the class path (`--class-path`)

   ```shell
   java \
     --class-path './target/libs/*' \
     demo.Main
   ```

   The application will run and print the following

   ```
   Simple hello world application (without modules)
   Using Java 25.0.4.1
   Loaded as unmaned module (JAR file loaded through the class path)
   ```

   Run the application using the module path (`--module-path`)

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --module simple.hello.world.application.without.modules
   ```

   The application will run and print the following

   ```
   Simple hello world application (without modules)
   Using Java 25.0.4.1
   Loaded as module with Name: simple.hello.world.application.without.modules (JAR file loaded through the module path)
   ```
